acceptanceCriteria: A hosted dry-run of the reference templates over the replay set runs with no outward writes and its results are recorded.
PCH-V0-011 and PCH-V0-014 physical isolation are qualified on a real host with retained evidence, or each is recorded as unsupported with the reason.
No PCH-V0 witness is reported as passed without its own retained evidence.
body: The owner accepted the delivered scope of #398 (PCH-V0-001..008, PCH-V0-015) on 2026-10-05 and closed it with qualification NOT_RUN; V1-0545 was completed on that basis. Not run, now tracked here: (1) the hosted dry-run of the replay set, blocked on the historical replay set from the #395 follow-up; (2) physical isolation PCH-V0-011 and PCH-V0-014, which are unqualified. Recorded in docs/specs/postmerge-ci-host-v0.md and docs/build-log/2026-10-05-postmerge-issues-accepted-not-run.md.
title: Post-merge CI host: hosted dry-run of the replay set and physical isolation qualification (issue #398 follow-up)
